scope: Scholar level75-era reference and acquisition chains
authorship: Original concise walkthroughs and factual tables; source references retained per article.

articles.title: A Little Knowledge
articles.intro: Any job level 30+; access to the past via Cavernous Maw. Bring 12 Vellum. Finish on BLM, RDM, SMN or BLU with its special ability ready.
articles.body_html:
Before you start

Any job level 30+; access to the past via Cavernous Maw. Bring 12 Vellum. Finish on BLM, RDM, SMN or BLU with its special ability ready.

Steps

  1. Talk to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis (S) (J-8, first map), reached from Batallia Downs (S) (J-10). Accept the quest.
  2. Trade Erlene all 12 sheets of Vellum. You can buy them from the Auction House or obtain them through Tucker.
  3. As BLM, RDM, SMN or BLU, activate Manafont, Chainspell, Astral Flow or Azure Lore respectively. Talk to Erlene while that effect is active.
  4. Finish the scene, then change to Scholar at a Mog House. Next equipment quest: On Sabbatical at SCH 40.

Reward

Unlocks Scholar; Grimoire key item; Schultz Scholar title.

articles.title: Tucker
articles.intro: Vellum exchange for the Scholar unlock quest.
articles.body_html:
Find Tucker in Crawlers' Nest (S) (K-8).

  1. Start A Little Knowledge with Erlene first, then speak to Tucker.
  2. For the full unlock requirement, bring 144 Rolanberry (12 stacks). Make three trades of 48 berries (four stacks) to receive four Vellum each time.
  3. Take the resulting 12 Vellum to Erlene.

The reviewed Zenith base allows three exchanges, up to four Vellum each. Trading only one stack in each exchange will leave you short; use the full quantities above.

articles.title: On Sabbatical
articles.intro: Scholar level 40+; A Little Knowledge complete.
articles.body_html:
Before you start

Scholar level 40+; A Little Knowledge complete.

Steps

  1. Talk to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis (S) (J-8) on Scholar to receive Ulbrecht's Sealed Letter.
  2. Speak to Gentle Tiger in Bastok Markets (S) (H-6), by the Metalworks entrance. If another quest scene takes priority, talk again.
  3. Check Indescript Markings on the northern edge of (E-11) in Pashhow Marshlands (S) for Schultz's Sealed Letter. Nearby Peistes detect by sight; approach carefully.
  4. Return to Erlene for the scroll. For Downward Helix, reach SCH 50 and wait until the next Vana'diel day.

Reward

Klimaform scroll, usable at SCH 46.

articles.title: Downward Helix
articles.intro: Scholar level 50+; On Sabbatical complete. Zone and wait for the next Vana'diel day.
articles.body_html:
Before you start

Scholar level 50+; On Sabbatical complete. Zone and wait for the next Vana'diel day.

Steps

  1. Speak to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis (S) (J-8) as Scholar.
  2. Walk into Southern San d'Oria (S) from East Ronfaure (S) to trigger the scene. Teleporting directly into town does not replace this entrance.
  3. Return to Erlene and speak to her.
  4. Walk into Sauromugue Champaign (S) from Rolanberry Fields (S) for the next scene.
  5. Check Indescript Markings at the southeast edge of (J-7) for Ulbrecht's Mortarboard. If hidden by dusty weather, return when it clears.
  6. Return to Erlene for your bracers. Visit Loussaire for feet, legs and body; Seeing Blood-red is the headpiece quest.

Reward

Scholar's Bracers; unlocks Loussaire's three armor commissions.

articles.title: Seeing Blood-red
articles.intro: Scholar level 50+; Downward Helix complete; zone and wait for the next Vana'diel day.
articles.body_html:
Before you start

Scholar level 50+; Downward Helix complete; zone and wait for the next Vana'diel day.

Steps

  1. Speak to Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis (S) (J-8) on Scholar.
  2. Check Indescript Markings at Pashhow Marshlands (S) (E-11) for the Unaddressed Sealed Letter.
  3. Return to Erlene for a scene. Read the letter in Temporary Key Items, then speak again for a Porting Magic Transcript.
  4. Enter the cave opposite the waterfall on the (E-10)/(F-10) boundary in Grauberg (S). Check the sparkling light, then the Indescript Markings.
  5. The party leader must have the active quest and entry key item. The retail battlefield in Ruhotz Silvermines allows up to six players and 30 minutes; you may fight on another job.
  6. Fight Ulbrecht until he concedes at roughly 20% HP. Save defensive resources for his Tabula Rasa around half HP. Return to Erlene for the headpiece.
  7. After a failed attempt, trade one Vellum to Erlene for a replacement transcript.

Reward

Scholar's Mortarboard; Summa Cum Laude title.

Zenith availability

Retail walkthrough supplied for reference. The reviewed base revision does not contain a complete Seeing Blood-red / Ulbrecht instance handler. Completion and Trust entry on Zenith are not confirmed; do not spend retry materials until the encounter is verified.

articles.title: Loussaire
articles.intro: Scholar AF commissions in Bastok Markets (S).
articles.body_html:
Location: Bastok Markets (S) (G-10). Complete Downward Helix and speak on SCH 50+. Choose one piece, collect its two key items, and return on Scholar with inventory space.

PieceRequired key itemsGuide
Scholar's LoafersRafflesia Dreamspit + Drogarogan BonemealScholar's Loafers Quest
Scholar's PantsSlug Mucus + Djinn EmberScholar's Pants Quest
Scholar's GownPeiste Dung + Sample of Grauberg ChertScholar's Gown Quest

These are commissions rather than ordinary quest-log entries. Start the selected piece before searching for its markings. Historical retail guides require a zone change and a new game day between pieces; the reviewed Loussaire handler does not enforce that delay. Speak again after collection.

articles.title: Scholar's Loafers Quest
articles.intro: SCH 50+; Downward Helix complete; choose Loafers from Loussaire in Bastok Markets (S) (G-10).
articles.body_html:
Before you start

SCH 50+; Downward Helix complete; choose Loafers from Loussaire in Bastok Markets (S) (G-10).

Steps

  1. In Fort Karugo-Narugo (S), search outdoor map 1 for Indescript Markings at (I-9), (I-10), (H-8), (G-7), (H-5) or (G-5). Check the active spot for Rafflesia Dreamspit; it moves after collection.
  2. In Meriphataud Mountains (S), check the markings at southwest (E-7), on the south side of Drogaroga's Spine, for Drogarogan Bonemeal. Historical appearance window: 07:00–17:00 game time.
  3. Return to Loussaire on Scholar with a free inventory slot. Checking these markings removes Sneak; renew protection before moving on.

Reward

Scholar's Loafers (SCH 54).

articles.title: Scholar's Pants Quest
articles.intro: SCH 50+; Downward Helix complete; choose Pants from Loussaire.
articles.body_html:
Before you start

SCH 50+; Downward Helix complete; choose Pants from Loussaire.

Steps

  1. Find Indescript Markings among Slugs in Pashhow Marshlands (S) at (K-5), (J-6), (I-6), (I-7) or (G-6) for Slug Mucus. The active spot moves after collection.
  2. Check the markings on the fire at Vunkerl Inlet (S) (D-11), near the Jugner Forest (S) entrance, for Djinn Ember. Historical guides recommend 16:00–06:00; weather-related reports conflict, so use a visible marker rather than assuming it must be absent.
  3. Return to Loussaire on Scholar with inventory space. Markings remove Sneak; watch the surrounding Djinn.

Reward

Scholar's Pants (SCH 56).

articles.title: Scholar's Gown Quest
articles.intro: SCH 50+; Downward Helix complete; choose Gown from Loussaire.
articles.body_html:
Before you start

SCH 50+; Downward Helix complete; choose Gown from Loussaire.

Steps

  1. Search the Peiste area of Pashhow Marshlands (S) for Indescript Markings: (K-8), (K-9), (J-9), (K-10), (J-10), (I-10) or (H-10). Collect Peiste Dung; the active spot moves.
  2. At the stone pillars in Grauberg (S) (D-8), check Indescript Markings for a Sample of Grauberg Chert. Inspect around the pillars; the marker relocates after use.
  3. Return to Loussaire on Scholar with a free slot. Checking a marker removes Sneak. Retail reports disagree about rain/wind restrictions; the reviewed collection handler does not test weather.

Reward

Scholar's Gown (SCH 58).

articles.title: Scholar Artifact Upgrades
articles.intro: Complete recipes for Scholar artifact armor +1.
articles.body_html:
Unlock Sea / Garden of Antiquity and speak to Sagheera in Port Jeuno (I-8). Every piece requires the original armor, one Electrum Stud from Apollyon, and one Brilliantine from Temenos.

Upgrade (SCH 74)Ancient BeastcoinsAdditional material
Scholar's Mortarboard +120Electrum Ingot ×1
Scholar's Gown +140Lynx Leather ×1
Scholar's Bracers +125Lynx Leather ×1
Scholar's Pants +125Ether Leather ×1
Scholar's Loafers +125Karakul Cloth ×1
  1. Collect the two Limbus materials and the crafted item. The crafted material can be purchased from the Auction House.
  2. Deposit the listed Ancient Beastcoins with Sagheera separately. Then trade the four recipe items together.
  3. Wait until the next Vana'diel midnight and speak to Sagheera to collect. Finish the current order before starting another.

The listed costs follow the reviewed Zenith base: Mortarboard 20, Gown 40, and 25 for each other slot. This avoids conflicting retail-wiki tables.

articles.title: Scholar Stratagems

articles.title: Layton
articles.intro: Scholar magic vendor in The Eldieme Necropolis (S).
articles.body_html:
Find Layton near Erlene in The Eldieme Necropolis (S) (J-8). Buy the Storm and Helix scrolls here, then use each scroll when your Scholar meets its learning level.

Scholar Spell List shows the historical 75 progression. Klimaform is a quest reward from On Sabbatical, not part of the ordinary Storm/Helix purchase route.

articles.title: Scholar
articles.intro: SCH is a Wings of the Goddess job that switches between healing/support and black magic through Arts and stratagems.
articles.body_html:
Unlock and progression

Unlock with A Little Knowledge at level 30. Begin On Sabbatical at SCH 40; continue Downward Helix at SCH 50 for artifact armor and Loussaire commissions.

Job abilities through 75

LevelAbilityPractical use
1Tabula RasaOpens both Arts and removes stratagem-charge costs during the effect.
10Light ArtsUse for healing, support and white magic.
10Dark ArtsUse for elemental, dark and black enfeebling magic.
35SublimationFirst activation stores MP while draining HP; activate again to recover stored MP.
65Modus VeritasUse on a Helix effect to increase damage per tick while shortening its remaining duration.
75 meritEnlightenmentSpend merits to unlock; permits one spell outside your current Addendum.

Traits

LevelTrait
10Resist Silence
20Clear Mind
25Conserve MP
30Max MP Boost
35Clear Mind II
40Resist Silence II
50Clear Mind III
65Clear Mind IV
70Resist Silence III
75 meritStormsurge

Stratagems and magic

Use Scholar Stratagems for every Light/Dark pair and charge timings. Scholar Spell List lists the complete historical 75 main-job spell progression and links to acquisition sources.

Skill ratings at 75

SkillRankBase cap 75
Club / StaffC+230
Dagger / ThrowingD210
Evasion / ParryingE200
Divine / Healing / Enhancing / Enfeebling / Elemental / DarkD210

Light Arts raises Divine, Healing, Enhancing and Enfeebling to B+ (256 at 75). Dark Arts raises Dark, Elemental and Enfeebling to B+ (256). Gear and merits can add skill beyond these base values.

Accessory: Argute Belt (70). Open any piece for its stats, source, quest or exact upgrade ingredients. Scholar Artifact Upgrades and Scholar Relic Upgrades collect the recipes.

Weapons

The first AF quest gives Klimaform instead of a weapon. Scholar can use Staff, Club and Dagger; Elemental Staves are common magic tools at 51. Its level 75 Mythic staff is Tupsimati, associated with Omniscience. Standard 75 Claustrum is for BLM/SMN, not Scholar.

Level75 merits

GroupOptions
1Grimoire Recast; Modus Veritas Duration; Helix Magic Accuracy/Attack; Maximum Sublimation.
2Altruism; Focalization; Tranquility; Equanimity; Enlightenment; Stormsurge.

Quick use

  1. For healing, select Light Arts and Addendum: White when status-removal or Reraise spells are needed.
  2. For damage, select Dark Arts. Use Addendum: Black for Sleep, Dispel and tierIV nukes.
  3. Match a Storm to the element you plan to cast; use Klimaform when available. Save charges for spells that matter.
  4. Charge Sublimation between MP demands, then activate it again when you need the stored MP.

This page follows historical 75 progression. Zenith-specific custom changes should be read from its dedicated job-balance notes; a level 75 cap alone does not prove every later base-game spell adjustment is disabled.

articles.title: Tabula Rasa
articles.intro: Scholar level 1.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Unlocked by reaching the listed Scholar level.

How to use

Activate when you need several stratagems in succession. During its short effect, stratagem use does not spend charges and both white and black magic receive the Grimoire benefits.

The historical special ability has a two-hour recast. Kaustra and Embrava were added after the level 75 era and are not included in this reference.

Related: Scholar · Scholar Stratagems · Scholar Spell List

articles.title: Light Arts
articles.intro: Scholar level 10.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Unlocked by reaching the listed Scholar level.

How to use

Activate before healing, protective buffs or white enfeebling magic. White magic becomes more efficient; the relevant low magic skills are raised to B+ rank.

Use Addendum: White when you need Scholar's additional white spells. Switching to Dark Arts removes that Addendum.

Related: Scholar · Scholar Stratagems · Scholar Spell List

articles.title: Dark Arts
articles.intro: Scholar level 10.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Unlocked by reaching the listed Scholar level.

How to use

Activate before elemental damage, dark magic or black enfeebling magic. Black magic becomes more efficient; the relevant low magic skills are raised to B+ rank.

Use Addendum: Black for Sleep, Dispel and high-tier spells. Switching to Light Arts removes that Addendum.

Related: Scholar · Scholar Stratagems · Scholar Spell List

articles.title: Sublimation
articles.intro: Scholar level 35.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Unlocked by reaching the listed Scholar level.

How to use

Activate once to store MP while your HP slowly decreases. Activate again when you need the stored MP. Storage stops when full or when HP becomes too low.

Prepare it between MP demands. The HP drain interferes with resting unless prevented; do not assume Refresh and Sublimation will operate together.

Related: Scholar · Scholar Stratagems · Scholar Spell List

articles.title: Modus Veritas
articles.intro: Scholar level 65.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Unlocked by reaching the listed Scholar level.

How to use

Land a Helix spell on the enemy, then use this ability on that enemy. It increases the Helix damage per tick while shortening the remaining duration.

It needs an active Helix effect and can fail. It is not an ordinary direct-damage spell; save it for a useful Helix already on the target.

Related: Scholar · Scholar Stratagems · Scholar Spell List

articles.title: Enlightenment
articles.intro: Scholar level 75 merit.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Reach Scholar75, enable merits and purchase Enlightenment in Scholar Group 2.

How to use

Unlock the ability in Scholar Group 2 merits. Activate it, then cast the needed learned spell that is normally locked behind an Addendum.

It provides access for the next spell; it does not permanently change your Arts or teach a missing scroll.

Related: Scholar · Scholar Stratagems · Scholar Spell List

articles.title: Stormsurge
articles.intro: Scholar Group 2 merit trait at level 75.
articles.body_html:
Purchase Stormsurge with merits. Storm spells you cast then add a bonus to an attribute associated with their element. More upgrades increase the bonus.

StormAttribute
FirestormSTR
SandstormVIT
RainstormMND
WindstormAGI
HailstormINT
ThunderstormDEX
AurorastormCHR
VoidstormAll seven attributes at reduced potency

Cast the relevant Storm on the party member who benefits. You still need its scroll and required casting level.

articles.title: Sandstorm
articles.intro: SCH 41 in the level 75 era · Earth weather · Enhancing magic.
articles.body_html:
Learn the spell

  1. Buy the scroll from Layton in The Eldieme Necropolis (S) (J-8), or buy it from the Auction House.
  2. Use the scroll at the required Scholar level.

Use

Gives one party member a single-weather effect of the listed element. It can support matching elemental magic and weather-sensitive equipment. Accession can spread the buff to nearby party members.

Pair it with Geohelix or Klimaform. Stormsurge adds an attribute bonus after purchasing the merit trait.

This is the historical learning level. Later retail lowered some Storm levels; follow the scroll requirement shown in Zenith if it differs.

articles.title: Geohelix
articles.intro: SCH 61 in the level 75 era · Earth damage over time · Elemental magic.
articles.body_html:
Learn the spell

  1. Buy its scroll from Layton in The Eldieme Necropolis (S) (J-8), or the Auction House.
  2. Use the scroll at the required Scholar level.

Use

  1. Select Dark Arts. Use Sandstorm to provide matching weather when helpful.
  2. Cast Geohelix on the enemy. It deals initial damage followed by repeated damage. Avoid applying it to a target your party needs to keep asleep.
  3. Use Modus Veritas after the Helix lands if you want to concentrate its damage into a shorter remaining period.

Historical learning level shown. Later retail moved Helix spells much earlier; this page does not assume Zenith has reverted those changes.

articles.title: Klimaform
articles.intro: SCH 46 · Dark magic · Scholar artifact-quest reward.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Complete On Sabbatical, available at SCH 40 after unlocking Scholar. Its reward is the Klimaform scroll; learn it at SCH 46.

Use

  1. Give yourself weather matching the element you plan to cast, using a Storm spell when needed.
  2. Cast Klimaform on yourself.
  3. Cast spells of the matching element while its effect lasts for improved magic accuracy.

The spell depends on matching weather. It is not a damage spell and is not an AF weapon.

articles.title: Vellum
articles.intro: Material required for Scholar unlock and AF3 retry transcripts.
articles.body_html:
For A Little Knowledge, bring 12 sheets. Buy them from the Auction House, or start the quest and use Tucker's exchange in Crawlers' Nest (S).

The full Tucker route is 144 Rolanberries, traded as three batches of 48 for four Vellum each. See his page before exchanging; the reviewed base limits the number of trades.

articles.title: Elder Staff
articles.intro: Staff · SCH 75 · DMG55 · Delay402.
articles.body_html:
Obtain from notorious monsters in Nyzul Isle Investigation. On the documented floor 100 route, the player selecting the starting floor should be Scholar: the boss drops a weapon matching that player's job.

What to do with it

  • Equip it and start Unlocking a Myth (Scholar) to unlock Omniscience.
  • It is also the starting Scholar weapon used in the Tupsimati Mythic chain. Unlocking the weapon skill alone does not build the Mythic weapon.

articles.title: Unlocking a Myth (Scholar)
articles.intro: Scholar75; Treasures of Aht Urhgan access; Elder Staff and personal Runic Disc.
articles.body_html:
Before you start

Scholar75; Treasures of Aht Urhgan access; Elder Staff and personal Runic Disc.

Steps

  1. Equip Elder Staff as your main weapon. Talk to Zalsuhm in Muckvix's Junk Shop, Lower Jeuno (H-9), and accept his offer.
  2. Build weapon-skill points while Elder Staff remains equipped, fighting experience-yielding enemies. Weapon skills and closing skillchains earn points.
  3. Historical requirement depends on your own saved Nyzul progress: clearing floor 100 reduces it to 250 points; no progress requires 16000. Completing someone else's floor 100 run does not automatically give your disc that progress.
  4. When Omniscience appears in the weapon-skill list with Elder Staff equipped, trade the staff to Zalsuhm to finish the unlock.

Reward

Omniscience permanently usable as Scholar with an equipped staff.

Zenith availability

Retail reduced every floor tier to 250 points in July 2014. Zenith's exact floor/point rule must be checked in its active implementation; this guide labels the historical rule rather than assuming the later reduction.

articles.title: Omniscience
articles.intro: Scholar Mythic staff weapon skill.
articles.body_html:
Deals darkness damage and can reduce the target's magic attack. It is associated with Tupsimati.

How to learn

Complete Unlocking a Myth (Scholar) using Elder Staff from Nyzul. This quest allows use with other staves on Scholar; finishing a Tupsimati is not required for the standalone unlock.

articles.title: Tupsimati
articles.intro: Staff · SCH 75 · Mythic weapon.
articles.body_html:
Level75 version: DMG62, Delay402, Accuracy+30, Magic Accuracy+10 and Magic Attack Bonus+20. Matching elemental weather reduces enmity; Omniscience activates its Mythic aftermath.

How to obtain

  1. Obtain Elder Staff from Nyzul Isle Investigation.
  2. Meet the Captain-rank and story requirements in An Imperial Heist, then begin the Mythic chain with your Scholar weapon.
  3. Continue Duties, Tasks, and Deeds, Forging a New Myth and Coming Full Circle. Follow those quest pages for the title checks, currencies, materials and final battle.

This page describes the level 75 weapon. Higher-level Trial of the Magians upgrades are outside this era guide. For only the weapon skill, use Unlocking a Myth (Scholar) instead.

articles.title: Electrum Ingot
articles.intro: Goldsmithing material for Scholar's Mortarboard +1.
articles.body_html:
Buy from Auction House → Materials → Goldsmithing. Standard synthesis: Goldsmithing42, Fire Crystal, Silver Ore ×1 and Gold Ore ×3; yield one ingot.

Use one in Scholar's Mortarboard +1. This is the ordinary recipe; Horizon's custom Terminal Alloy recipe is not assumed to exist on Zenith.

articles.title: Lynx Leather
articles.intro: Leathercraft material used in Scholar artifact and relic upgrades.
articles.body_html:
Buy from Auction House → Materials → Leathercraft. Standard synthesis: Leathercraft71, Dark Crystal, Lynx Hide ×1, Windurstian Tea Leaves ×1 and Distilled Water ×1; yield one leather.

Farm Lynx Hide from Lynxes in Meriphataud Mountains (S) or purchase the hide. Use the finished leather for Scholar's Gown +1, Scholar's Bracers +1 or Argute Bracers +1.

articles.title: Incombustible Wool
articles.intro: Clothcraft material, abbreviated Incomb. Wool in the game.
articles.body_html:
Buy from Auction House → Materials → Clothcraft. One square is required for Argute Loafers +1. Ordinary Wool Cloth is a different item and cannot replace it.

The synthesis uses Clothcraft37 and Cloth Ensorcellment: Earth Crystal, Wool Thread ×3, Fire Anima ×1, Ice Anima ×1 and Dark Anima ×1. A crafter with the required key item can make it.
